overview.about: The Farmers Insurance Open is played on the clifftop Torrey Pines Golf Course above the Pacific in San Diego - a municipal layout tough enough to host the US Open. The South Course's length and ocean wind make it one of the sternest regular-season tests on the PGA Tour.
overview.nextEvent: The next Farmers Insurance Open is contested across Torrey Pines' South and North courses in San Diego, with the closing rounds on the longer South. Tiger Woods has a storied history on these cliffs.
